title: Concept: Azure SAS token in a response
description: A storage URL that carries a shared access signature in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The signature grants time-boxed access to the container or blob, so anyone who reads the response can download or overwrite the object until the signature expires.
applicability: Deployments that render a storage URL that carries a shared access signature into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The signature grants time-boxed access to the container or blob, so anyone who reads the response can download or overwrite the object until the signature expires.
